# Expected output spec for `jankurai postmortem record` verb fixtures.

[fixture: positive/atlas-2026-05.toml]
$ jankurai postmortem record positive/atlas-2026-05.toml
exit_code: 0
required diagnostic line: "written to .jankurai/postmortems/2026-05-phase-3d-atlas.toml"
side effect: file exists at .jankurai/postmortems/2026-05-phase-3d-atlas.toml with content equivalent to input
  (canonical-hash equality, not string equality — allow comment / whitespace normalization)

[fixture: adversarial_missing_failure_mode.toml]
$ jankurai postmortem record adversarial_missing_failure_mode.toml
exit_code: 1
required diagnostic line: "missing required field: failure_mode"

[fixture: adversarial_invalid_failure_mode.toml]
$ jankurai postmortem record adversarial_invalid_failure_mode.toml
exit_code: 1
required diagnostic lines:
  - "invalid enum value for failure_mode"
  - "totally-made-up-mode"
  - "valid values:"
  - "aspirational-spec, env-prerequisite, interop-runtime, equivalence-gap, cutover-rollback, perf-regression"
    (substring; the line listing the enum values must include all six)

[fixture: adversarial_outcome_typo.toml]
$ jankurai postmortem record adversarial_outcome_typo.toml
exit_code: 1
required diagnostic lines:
  - "invalid enum value for outcome"
  - "blocked-ish"
  - "did you mean: blocked"      # close-match suggestion is OPTIONAL but if produced must point at the right enum

[fixture: adversarial_missing_lessons.toml]
$ jankurai postmortem record adversarial_missing_lessons.toml
exit_code: 1
required diagnostic line: "missing required section: [lessons]"

[Rule 9 — evidence over labels]
The verb MUST parse the TOML with a real parser (toml/tomli/serde_toml) and
validate against the schema, not regex-match the field names against the
text. Specifically:
  - A comment line like `# failure_mode = "env-prerequisite"` (commented out)
    MUST NOT satisfy the required-field check.
  - A field that's present but with a typo MUST be detected (not silently
    coerced).
  - The accept path MUST also write the postmortem out and re-read it to
    confirm round-trip equivalence (hash-based check).
